intro.title: Serpentine Stone
intro.description: Serpentine gemstone has been regarded as a powerful stone associated with protection and other mystic and healing properties since ancient times. The word serpentine is derived from the Latin word Serpentinus which means Stone Serpent. The name appears obvious due to the green color and rough texture of the gemstone which evokes similarity with the skin of a reptile.

tabs.tab2_description:
Serpentine gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits; it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Serpentine. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Heart or the Anahata Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those who are looking for the blessing of cordial and harmonious relationships.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses users with compassion, love and contentment. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Serpentine is a superb stone to use when forming an exciting new partnership. It will keep away those who do not share your values, especially those who would exploit and discard you. Concurrently, the Serpentine stone facilitates the opening of the heart. It fosters you to try new things while protecting you from any potential risks that may be involved.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Serpentine gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated gemstones.

Serpentine Gemstone Buying Guide

When buying a serpentine gemstone, there are few factors to keep in mind to ensure that you are getting a premium quality stone.

Check the Origin:

Serpentine gemstones are found in various locations worldwide, including the United States, China, Russia, and Afghanistan. The origin of the stone can sometimes affect its quality and value. Look for serpentine gemstones from renowned sources such as Italy, Brazil, Africa known for producing high-quality stones.

Observe the Color:

Serpentine gemstones come in various shades of green color. The intensity and hue of the color can vary greatly. Look for a stone which has vibrant and rich colors that are visually appealing.

Notice the Clarity:

Serpentine gemstones typically have some natural inclusions, such as veins or variations in color. These inclusions are often considered part of the stone's character. However, avoid stones with excessive cracks, fractures, or cloudy appearances, as these can impact the overall beauty and durability of the gemstone.

Examine the Texture:

Serpentine gemstones are known for their unique texture, which can range from smooth and glassy to rough and grainy. The texture can add to the stone's charm and character. It is recommended to choose a serpentine gemstone with a texture that appeals and complements its color and clarity.

Consider the Shape:

Serpentine gemstones are available in various shapes, including round, oval, pear, and cabochon. The choice of shape is largely a matter of personal preference.

Check for Treatment:

Serpentine gemstones are generally not treated or enhanced. However, it is still important to confirm whether the stone is natural and has undergone any treatments, such as dyeing or oiling. Natural, untreated serpentine gemstones are highly valued, so ensure that you are purchasing a genuine, natural, untreated stone.

Check the Carats:

It is recommended to wear Serpentine between 5-7 carats, some people also suggest wearing 1/12th of your body weight in carat weight which means if you weigh 60 Kgs you can wear 5 Carats stone.

Check for Lab Certificate:

To ensure the authenticity and quality of the serpentine gemstone, it is advisable to request a certificate from a reputable gemological laboratory. The certificate should provide information about the gemstone's origin, treatment status, and any additional details that validate its quality and value.

Why buy Serpentine from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Serpentine gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated and untreated Serpentine gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvik nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Serpentine is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).

Color

The best quality Serpentine gemstones are rich green in color with vivid and vibrant color saturation, hue and tone. The color should be evenly distributed with no visible color-zone.

Cut

Best quality Serpentine stone have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

Serpentine stone of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Serpentine are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of blue sapphire rises dramatically as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Serpentine stone is an opaque stone, the best quality ones are smooth with no eye visible inclusions, cracks and scratches.

Dealers deal in Serpentine which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Serpentine gemstone Price

The price of Serpentine stone depends upon various factors such as quality (4Cs), origin, treatment among others. Depending upon the color, clarity and cut, opals can be categorized as of low, medium and premium quality. Low quality Serpentine stones are available at a few dollars per carat/ratti whereas premium quality stones go for upward of thousand dollars per carat/ratti.

Please note that we at Rudra Centre deal only in 100% natural untreated and unheated premium quality certified Serpentine sourced responsibly from all over the world.

The price of natural, unheated and untreated serpentine gemstone from Rudra Centre ranges between INR 5,290 – INR 6,485 (USD 66 – USD 80).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Serpentine?

The best way to check the authenticity of Serpentine is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Serpentine are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Serpentine carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Serpentine is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Serpentine have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Serpentine, but if you find flaws, then your Serpentine is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles.

Essentially, lab-created Serpentine is glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Serpentine. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Serpentine, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Serpentine from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Serpentine. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Serpentine. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Serpentine Cleaning & Maintenance

The best method for cleaning serpentine gems and jewelry is to rinse them with mild soap and water (steaming, ultrasonic, and boiling methods are not recommended).

Use a soft, untreated clothes that is not embedded with abrasive substances such as rouge to clean the surface. Before wearing or storing, thoroughly dry gemstones and settings.

After applying cosmetics and perfume, put on your serpentine jewelry.
